rows.grounds: absolutive expressing prior action of meditation
compound specifying the seed as supreme; object of chanting

items.question: What practice must follow meditating on the seed-syllable in the lotus?
premises: The practitioner has meditated on the seed-syllable.
The instruction is addressed to the great goddess.
The prescribed act is chanting the supreme seed-syllable.
items.inference: After meditating on the seed-syllable, one should chant the supreme seed-syllable.
uncertainties: The specific bīja syllable intended by bījamuttamam is not explicitly named in this verse.
items.plain_english: O great goddess, having meditated on the seed-syllable, one should chant the supreme seed-syllable.
